JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 15466/2022 Jitendra Kumar S/o Prakash Kumar, Aged About 22 Years, R/o Meghwalo Ka Bada Bas Koselaw Ps Takhatgarh Pali Dist. (Lodged At Dist. Jail Pali)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. JVS Deora

For Respondent(s) : Mr. MA Siddiqui, AAG  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MADAN GOPAL VYAS Order 21/04/2023 The present criminal misc. bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. has been preferred by the petitioner in connection with FIR no.77/2022, Police Station Takhatgarh, District Pali lodged for the offences under Sections 376 and 506 IPC, Section 3/4 of the POCSO Act and under Section 67B of the Information and Technology Act.
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has falsely been implicated in the present case.
It is submitted that in the present case most of the witnesses have been examined and PW-5 Dr.-Prabha Charan deposed that there is no sign of recent forceful sexual assault.
It is submitted that the petitioner is behind the bars since long, therefore, he may be enlarged on bail.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor opposed the prayer made by learned counsel for the petitioner.

[2023/RJJD/011523] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-15466/2022] Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the material available on record.

sentences.text:
Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, after perusing the statements recorded under Section 161 of Cr.P.C. and looking to the gravity of the offence committed in the present case,
without commenting on the merits and demerits of the case, I do not find it to be a fit case for grant of bail.
The bail application is therefore, rejected.
However, the learned trial court is directed to expedite the trial of the case.
A copy of this order be sent to the trial court by email or by FAX.

(MADAN GOPAL VYAS),J 101-CPGoyal/-
